hook: The Spreckels Mansion — a 34-room 1911 house and Article 10 individual landmark filling a Pacific Heights block.

parcel.note: Class-B (non-combustible) construction. The assessor records year built as 1911; the prompting article gives 1912.

assessment.note: No sale recorded on the current roll.

historic_status.reason: Article 10 Individual Landmark, Historic Survey Result
historic_status.landmark_note: One published account gives San Francisco Landmark No. 197, designated 9 June 1990. The city's per-parcel historic dataset confirms Article 10 individual-landmark status but does not carry the landmark number or designation date.

notable_residents_omitted.note: The prompting article names a current resident of this house. Under this site's privacy rules — which bar naming or alluding to current occupants, publicly available or not — that claim is omitted. Past, dated residency tied to a published source may be added later.

permit_summary.note: One is a sidewalk permit at a nominal valuation. The record centres on a 1990 kitchen-and-bath remodel and post-1989-earthquake parapet bracing.

permits.description: brace and secure the parapet with a system of steel angles
re-install the iron gate at the front entrance driveway
remodel the kitchen and two baths, with miscellaneous electrical, plumbing and cabinetry

sections.heading: Historic status
sections.body: One published account gives San Francisco Landmark No. 197, designated 9 June 1990. The city's per-parcel historic dataset confirms the Article 10 individual-landmark status and the Category A / A* rating, but carries neither the landmark number nor the designation date, so those two figures remain unverified against the landmark ordinance itself.
